Pune train services to be disrupted on July 5 due to maintenance

Train services in Pune will experience disruptions on July 5 due to a planned nine-hour maintenance block in the Pune Yard. The block is scheduled to affect train operations for the entire day. This maintenance is necessary for the upkeep of railway infrastructure.
